aboutGame.title: What is Breakout Garage?
paragraphs: Breakout Garage is an open-world driving and racing simulator from Breakout Studio, set in a Texas-inspired small town where classic American muscle cars are bought, repaired, rebuilt, and tuned by hand. It entered Steam Early Access on September 22, 2026 with 5 cars, 3 engine types, and simple races covering drag racing, oval events, drift, time trials, and endurance runs.

The core loop is Buy, Repair, Build, Tune, Race, Earn, Upgrade. Deep engine tuning covers airflow, air-fuel ratio, ignition timing, compression, boost, gear ratios, suspension, tires, weight, and aero, while Peer-to-Peer multiplayer lets you race friends in the in-game Race Lobby. Our wiki documents every system with guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Breakout Garage FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Breakout Garage.

items.question: What is Breakout Garage?
items.answer: Breakout Garage is an open-world racing and car-building simulator from Breakout Studio, set in a Texas-inspired town with classic American muscle cars. It launched on Steam Early Access on September 22, 2026 with 5 cars, 3 engine types, and drag, oval, drift, time trial, and endurance events.

items.question: Is Breakout Garage free to play?
items.answer: No. Breakout Garage is a paid PC game sold on Steam and is currently in Early Access. There are no confirmed codes or free-currency systems for Breakout Garage.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Breakout Garage?
items.answer: Start with tires, brakes, and fluids, then suspension and alignment, then gearing. Add engine power last, because unusable power simply spins the tires in Breakout Garage.

items.question: How many cars are in Breakout Garage?
items.answer: The Early Access launch build includes 5 cars and 3 engine types. The developers plan to expand the Breakout Garage roster, parts, and career content over time.

items.question: Does Breakout Garage have multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Breakout Garage supports Peer-to-Peer multiplayer, so you can host a lobby and race friends in the in-game Race Lobby.

items.question: How do I make money in Breakout Garage?
items.answer: Race events, delivery jobs, daily objectives, and flipping used cars are the main income sources in Breakout Garage. End every session by selling surplus parts and reinvesting in your build.
